whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm .yarnrc no longer carries a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false.
